# FreeTradeJournal

> FreeTradeJournal is a free web-based trading journal for forex, futures, stock and prop-firm traders. Log trades, import broker CSVs or screenshots, track P&L and analytics, journal your sessions, and get AI coaching based only on your own trades. The core journal is free with no credit card. Pro is $12.99/month or $99.99/year, no trial, cancel anytime.

Website: https://www.freetradejournal.com
Live demo: the "View Live Demo" button on the home page opens the full app with sample data, no account needed.
Support: support@freetradejournal.com

## What it is

- A browser-based trading journal (also installs as a PWA on mobile). No download.
- Markets: forex, futures (ES, NQ, CL, MES, MNQ and others), stocks, crypto, indices.
- Prop-firm support: FTMO, Topstep, Apex Trader Funding, The5ers, MyFundedFutures and custom firms. PropTracker tracks evaluation and funded-account rules (drawdown, daily loss, profit target).
- Imports: CSV from any broker with automatic column mapping. Recognises MetaTrader 4/5, Tradovate, NinjaTrader, DAS Trader and TopstepX exports (order-per-row exports are paired into trades automatically). Screenshot import: upload an image of your closed trades from MT4/MT5, TradingView, TopstepX, Tradovate, NinjaTrader or a broker app and the trades are extracted.
- Analytics: win rate, profit factor, expectancy, average R:R, max drawdown, largest and average win/loss, streaks, calendar heatmap, equity curve, daily/weekly/monthly P&L, breakdowns by symbol, strategy, account and weekday.
- Journal: daily and per-trade entries, screenshots, emotion tagging, templates.
- Goals and risk rules: profit targets, max daily loss, max trades per day, with alerts.
- AI (uses only your own trade data, no market predictions or signals): Coach FTJ chat, AI trade review, journal review (what you wrote vs what you did), strategy tagger, risk alerts.
- Multi-account: separate accounts per broker or prop firm, plus a combined view.
- Data export to CSV at any time. Data is stored per-user; Pro adds encrypted cloud sync across devices.

## Pricing (as of August 2026)

- Free: unlimited trades, up to 2 trading accounts, 1 PropTracker account, dashboard analytics over the trailing 30 days, 20 journal entries, 20 AI queries per month, 3 screenshot imports total, CSV import and export. No credit card.
- Pro: $12.99/month or $99.99/year. Removes the free limits (all-time analytics, unlimited journal entries, unlimited accounts, unlimited PropTracker accounts), adds cloud sync across devices, much higher AI limits, priority support. No free trial; the free plan has no time limit. Cancel anytime.
- No lifetime plan is sold (retired 7 August 2026).

## Who it is for

Retail and prop-firm traders who want a journal that is free to start, works for forex and futures (not only US stocks), and includes AI coaching without a $30-plus per month subscription. Common comparisons: TradeZella (no free plan, from $35/month), TraderSync (no free plan, from $29.95/month), Edgewonk ($197 per year term), Tradervue (free plan capped at 30 trades per month).
